title: The temporary hosted-only merge gate is retired: the full DEC-0015 matrix is the merge gate again
problem: DEC-0025 temporarily made the GitHub-hosted n8n-lego Gate the effective merge gate while the 10-runner self-hosted fleet was offline, because the six required self-hosted DEC-0015 jobs never left queued. That condition has ended: the fleet is back and running the full matrix (9/9 checks green on PR #347 head ca128f56, including Level 0, Level 1, Level 2 linux/windows, Conformance and the Windows worker portability probe), and the DEC-0015 back-fill re-ran every deferred self-hosted check against the merged main head (11/11 green on back-fill PR #348, head 03cbf7f7). Left ACTIVE, DEC-0025 would keep licensing merges that skip the required self-hosted checks — exactly the class of hidden failure its temporary rule tolerated.

options.summary: Supersede DEC-0025 through the repo's decision chain (state SUPERSEDED, supersededBy DEC-0027) and let the full DEC-0015 matrix stand as the merge gate again.
Keep DEC-0025 active indefinitely as a fallback gate for future fleet outages.
Delete DEC-0025 as if it never existed.

rationale: Option A follows the established supersession chain (DEC-0010 -> DEC-0017 -> DEC-0019): a temporary decision whose condition ended is retired by a successor decision, not deleted, so the history stays readable (C is history erasure and would remove the record of why a temporary gate existed). B would leave standing permission to merge without required checks whenever a runner stalls, which conflicts with the rule that every required check must be success on the current head and with the WAITING_RUNNER-is-never-PASS discipline of DEC-0015; a future outage is handled by a fresh, explicit temporary decision scoped to that outage, not by a dormant license. The merge gate from this point on is the full DEC-0015 matrix (Level 0, Level 1, Level 2 linux/windows, Conformance, Windows worker portability probe) plus the GitHub-hosted checks, on the exact head being merged.
evidenceRefs: docs/engineering-operations/workforce/decisions/DEC-0024.json (option A cites the same 9/9 full-matrix evidence)
REQ-0002 (Arena Manager master prompt 2026-09-27): hidden failure sweep - a temporary license to skip required checks is a standing hidden-failure risk once its condition ends
